networkPolicy.desc: Sign in pages only, for logins applications open in a browser

notes: A whitelist of sign in pages. The block page that stands in for the browser reads this list: a link to one of these hosts goes to Chrome, which reaches nothing else. Google, Microsoft and Apple accounts to start with; www.google.com is left out on purpose, since it is search. Add a host here when a report from the block page's "this site should be open" shows a login that needs it. Haniti (com.mot.haniti) signs in through a custom tab: transportation.outsystems.app, the Ministry of Transport portal, then login.gov.il, the national identity service; traced through a full sign in on a device. The gov.il pages also load Glassbox session analytics (cdn.gbqofs.com, report.govi.gbqofs.io), left out on purpose: with them blocked the sign in page still loads in full; a complete sign in has not yet been tried with them blocked.
